scenes.narration: ~Hear that? The basement door is open. And something down there knows your name.
You grab the flashlight. Moose tries to follow. His legs give out.
So you go down alone. Every step creaks. Then the whispering... stops.
scenes.visual: descending the stairs with a flashlight beam

scenes.narration: The basement is empty. Just an old furnace. Rumbling. Glowing through a crack in its side.
Your head is pounding. You lean on the wall. And something your dad once told you comes back.
scenes.visual: you leaning on the wall, dizzy

scenes.narration: No smell. No colour. It causes headaches, dizziness, confusion. Some people even hear things that aren't there. And pets can get sick first.
Headaches every morning. Moose too weak to stand. The whispers.
scenes.visual: quick flashes: you, the dog, the vent

scenes.narration: You follow the furnace pipe to the wall. It vents outside... straight into three feet of snow.
scenes.visual: exhaust pipe disappearing into a snow-blocked vent

scenes.narration: The snow buried the exhaust. Everything that furnace burns has nowhere to go... but into the house.
scenes.visual: furnace smoke curling back into the room

scenes.narration: Your vision blurs. Your legs feel heavy. The stairs look a mile long.
And from the top of the stairs, in your mother's voice... ~stay down here with us.
scenes.visual: top of the stairs, a dark doorway

scenes.narration: Get out? Tell me in the comments... part three is up next.
